cohort: All patients admitted to the Surgical ICU, Phase 3, Lahore General Hospital between November 1, 2019, and November 17, 2020.
finding: The overall mortality rate in the surgical ICU was 21.5%, with the highest mortality observed in patients with gastrointestinal surgery/disease (37.7%) and trauma (20%).
followup_time: Variable, up to the time of discharge or death during the study period (November 2019 to November 2020).
